reason: Thirty-six dollars for one lip balm is too much on my fixed income, especially when the drugstore has color-changing balms for under ten. The money-back promise is nice, but I'd still have to pay up front and then go through the trouble of sending it back if my lips react.
objection: The ad doesn't tell me what's in it. These color-changing balms usually have dyes and sometimes fragrance, and with my sensitive lips that's the first thing I worry about. Nobody has reviewed it yet, so I can't tell if anyone with sensitive lips has tried it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the full ingredient list right in the ad, with no fragrance and no dyes I know bother me, plus a smaller trial size for around $15.
